task_type: production regression repair and controlled release
requested_outcome: Repair the complete candidate, pass QQQAAA against the exact build, publish once, and verify the public version without regressing approved VII behavior
authorization_boundary: Local repair, testing, one controlled public publication after green gates, and live verification are authorized; destructive data changes and uncertain repeated publication are not authorized

lesson_bundle.reason: The release spans VII search, availability, galleries, sliders, administration and public page contracts
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use the master plan and accepted feedback standard as the product truth and test the affected family

lesson_bundle.reason: A public release cannot be approved from build success alone
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require full automated gates, exact candidate browser checks and representative public journeys

lesson_bundle.reason: The previous managed publication failed and the public site must remain recoverable
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze a clean commit, publish once, verify exact public routes and retain the v789 rollback reference

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local fix passes while another requested VII family silently regresses
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run all unit contracts plus the complete QQQAAA matrix across public, administration, search, availability, media and localization
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All release suites pass on the frozen candidate and no affected-family exclusion is unexplained

predicted_rejections.rejection: The managed build fails again because the deploy artifact exceeds the provider boundary
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the deterministic media reachability prune and fail-closed artifact budget in the production build
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact final build is below 220 MiB and every referenced asset remains resolvable

predicted_rejections.rejection: Tests pass against stale code or a different URL than the version that is published
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a clean commit, run local production browser checks on its build, publish that frozen source once and inspect the public destination
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Commit identity, QQQAAA report, managed version and live URL evidence refer to the same release

predicted_rejections.rejection: A retry or second deployment overwrites a known-good public version after an uncertain result
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one deployment operation identity, verify its outcome before any further action and retain the previous public rollback version
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: There is exactly one confirmed publication attempt and a verified rollback target

affected_family: search, redirects, localization and public navigation

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the clean build and full unit suite, before browser expansion and publication
checks: Build completes below the artifact budget
Candidate production server returns a complete homepage

attack_questions: Can the exact public version still show a failed or partial page after refresh?
Can mobile and desktop disagree on the repaired search, gallery or booking state?
Can a missing supplier response create invented availability or an empty unstable slider?
Can the release be rolled back immediately if the live destination differs from the candidate?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Live route, refresh, mobile and desktop evidence from https://vii.spaplus.co after publication
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: QQQAAA report plus targeted public route checks covering the affected families

effectiveness.baseline: v790 provider publication failed before deployment and earlier checks exposed stale test contracts that masked the exact release state
effectiveness.target: One frozen release, zero failed public journeys in the representative matrix, and no repeated uncertain deployment
